import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int NN = 202;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] flow = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[][] cap = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[] pre = new int[NN];
    static int[] que = new int[NN];
    static int[] d = new int[NN];

    static int edmondsKarp(int n, int source, int sink) {
        int p, q, t, i, j;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            d[source] = INF;
            p = q = 0;
            que[q++] = source;
            while (p < q && pre[sink] < 0) {
                t = que[p++];
                for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if (pre[i] < 0 && (j = cap[t][i] - flow[t][i]) > 0) {
                        pre[que[q] = i] = t;
                        que[q++] = i;
                        d[i] = Math.min(d[t], j);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[sink] < 0) break;
            for (i = sink; i != source; i = pre[i]) {
                flow[pre[i]][i] += d[sink];
                flow[i][pre[i]] -= d[sink];
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) total += flow[source][i];
        return total;
    }

    static char[][] gridA = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[11][11];
    static int zombieRow, zombieCol;
    static int[][] dirs = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    static int[][] distMatrix = new int[101][101];
    static int N, T;
    static List<Integer> sourceRows = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> sourceCols = new ArrayList<>();

    static void bfs(int startR, int startC, int[] distances, boolean isSourceCheck) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distances[startR * N + startC] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{startR, startC});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] curr = q.poll();
            int r = curr[0], c = curr[1];
            int idx = r * N + c;
            int curDist = distances[idx];
            if (isSourceCheck && (distMatrix[zombieRow * N + zombieCol][idx] <= curDist || T <= curDist)) {
                if (distMatrix[zombieRow * N + zombieCol][idx] < curDist || T < curDist) {
                    distances[idx] = INF + 1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dirs[k][0];
                int nc = c + dirs[k][1];
                if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr == N || nc == N) continue;
                if (gridB[nr][nc] < '0' || gridB[nr][nc] > '9') continue;
                int nidx = nr * N + nc;
                if (distances[nidx] != INF) continue;
                distances[nidx] = curDist + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    static void constructGraph() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridB[i][j] <= '0' || gridB[i][j] > '9') continue;
                sourceRows.add(i);
                sourceCols.add(j);
                int idx = i * N + j;
                cap[idx + 2 + N * N][1] = gridB[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        int zIdx = zombieRow * N + zombieCol;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] <= '0' || gridA[i][j] > '9') continue;
                int idx = i * N + j;
                cap[0][idx + 2] = gridA[i][j] - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < sourceRows.size(); ++k) {
                    int ri = sourceRows.get(k);
                    int ci = sourceCols.get(k);
                    int qIdx = ri * N + ci;
                    if (distMatrix[idx][qIdx] < INF) {
                        cap[idx + 2][qIdx + 2 + N * N] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distMatrix[i], INF);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridA[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridB[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        zombieRow = -1;
        zombieCol = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zombieRow = i;
                    zombieCol = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs(zombieRow, zombieCol, distMatrix[zombieRow * N + zombieCol], false);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '1' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs(i, j, distMatrix[i * N + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        constructGraph();
        System.out.println(edmondsKarp(2 + N * N + N * N, 0, 1));
    }
}
